Billing FAQ

Do I need to be home for the cleaning?

No. Just leave your bin out at the curb after your regular collection day — we do the rest and confirm by text when it’s finished.

What if I need to skip a month?

Just let us know before your route day. Subscriptions can be paused, skipped, or canceled with no fee.

Is there a charge if my bin isn’t empty?

Bins must be empty to be cleaned. If we arrive and yours still has trash in it, that visit is marked missed and reshuffled to the next available route, per our 24-hour notice policy.

Can you remove paint, tar, or years of buildup?

We’ll get as much as possible on the first visit. Bins that haven’t been cleaned in years sometimes need a second pass to fully break up old residue — we’ll always tell you up front if that’s the case.
